related_questions.question: How do I access my TD Ameritrade account?

text_blocks.snippet: To access your TD Ameritrade account, you'll need to go to the Schwab website or mobile app, as TD Ameritrade accounts were migrated to Schwab. If you haven't received communication from Schwab about your account, you'll need to wait for them to notify you about the migration. Once Schwab takes over your account, you can log in using your TD Ameritrade credentials (user ID and password) on the Schwab platform. If you previously had a Schwab account linked to your dashboard, you may need to re-enter your credentials to include the migrated TD Ameritrade account.

list.snippet: TD Ameritrade Acquisition: TD Ameritrade was acquired by Charles Schwab in 2020.
Account Migration: The final stages of migrating TD Ameritrade accounts to Schwab are underway.
Schwab Website or Mobile App: You'll access your account through Schwab's website or mobile app.
Login Credentials: If you have a TD Ameritrade account, you'll use your existing TD Ameritrade user ID and password to log in to your account on Schwab.
Waiting for Notification: If you haven't received communication from Schwab about your account, you'll need to wait for them to notify you about the migration.
Re-linking Accounts (if needed): If you previously had a Schwab account linked to your dashboard, you may need to re-enter your login credentials to include the migrated TD Ameritrade account.
